استطردا (form X)
# اِسْتَطْرَدَا (istaṭradā) /is.tatˤ.ra.daː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَطْرَدَ (istaṭrada)
# اُسْتُطْرِدَا (ustuṭridā) /us.tutˤ.ri.daː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَطْرَدَ (istaṭrada)
# اِسْتَطْرِدَا (istaṭridā) /is.tatˤ.ri.daː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَطْرَدَ (istaṭrada)
